newsitem.title: THAILAND: S.P. Suzuki takes loan to refinance debt.
newsitem.headline: S.P. Suzuki takes loan to refinance debt.

text.p: Thai motorcycle distributor, S.P. Suzuki Plc, said on Thursday it had signed a 3.17 billion yen syndicated term loan facility last week to refinance its baht-denominated debt.
The facility had been increased from an originally-proposed amount of 2.53 billion yen, S.P. Suzuki said in a statement.
Citicorp Investment Bank (Singapore) is the arranger of the loan and the Bangkok branch of the Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi is the lead manager, S.P. Suzuki said.
The company is one of the two exclusive distributors of Suzuki motorcycles in Thailand.
S.P. Suzuki said it sold 173,275 units in 1996, representing 14.04 percent of total motorcycle sales in Thailand.
